description: SPDX license expression parse and policy check — Parses up to 50 SPDX license expressions (AND, OR, WITH exceptions, + or-later, LicenseRef) and evaluates each against a caller policy (allow list, deny list, allowed exceptions, OSI/FSF flags, copyleft tier) for agents vetting dependency licenses. Returns the canonical expression, per-license flags from the pinned SPDX License List, the verdict, and which licenses satisfy an OR. Does not detect l

allow.description: If non-empty, only these SPDX ids pass (GPL-2.0-only and GPL-2.0 are the same entry; GPL-2.0+ means or-later and must be listed as such).

allowDeprecated.description: Default true: deprecated ids only add a witness. false: they fail.

allowExceptions.description: If non-empty, only these WITH exception ids pass.

allowLicenseRefs.description: LicenseRef-* ids the caller has reviewed; other refs yield unknown.

denyCopyleft.description: Id-family heuristic: strong = GPL/AGPL/SSPL/EUPL/OSL/CC-BY-SA; any adds LGPL/MPL/EPL/CDDL and similar.

expressions.description: SPDX expressions, e.g. 'MIT OR (GPL-2.0-only WITH Classpath-exception-2.0)'.

requireFsfLibre.description: Fail licenses without isFsfLibre in the SPDX list.

requireOsiApproved.description: Fail licenses without isOsiApproved in the SPDX list.

name: spdx-policy
